verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Come and bless the Lord
All you servants of the Lord
Who stand and serve in the house of the Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
We bless Your name
We bless Your name
We ascribe to You Lord
The glory due Your name

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
I lift my hands in Your sanctuary
For in Your temple all cry glory
I lift my hands in Your sanctuary
I bless Your name and I cry holy

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Worthy of glory
Worthy of honor
Worthy of power
Worthy of praise
